title: ATS Resume Checker for Freshers: The 10-Point Checklist Before Submitting Job Applications
description: Essential ATS resume checking guide for college students and fresh graduates. Learn how to score 90%+ on automated recruitment filters.

image.alt: 10-Point ATS Resume Checklist for College Freshers

body:
As a fresher applying for off-campus drives or summer internships, your resume competes against thousands of other applicants. Automated ATS parsers screen out over 75% of submissions before a human recruiter conducts a manual review. Here is the definitive 10-point checklist to ensure your resume scores in the top 95th percentile.

## 1. The 10-Point ATS Fresher Checklist

- 1. Single-Column Layout: Zero tables, sidebars, text boxes, or floating graphic containers.
- 2. Standard System Fonts: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, Calibri, or Computer Modern (LaTeX).
- 3. Standard Section Headers: Use 'Education', 'Technical Skills', 'Projects', and 'Work Experience'.
- 4. Direct Text Selectability: Ensure you can highlight and copy text from your exported PDF.
- 5. Exact Keyword Match: Mirror key terms from the job posting (e.g., 'RESTful APIs', 'PostgreSQL', 'Docker', 'State Management').
- 6. Active Bullet Starters: Begin every bullet with strong verbs ('Architected', 'Implemented', 'Engineered', 'Optimized', 'Refactored').
- 7. Measurable Outcomes: Include concrete numbers (queries optimized, users served, latency reduced, test coverage percentage).
- 8. Clickable Live Links: Ensure GitHub repo links and hosted web app URLs are verified and active.
- 9. Clean File Naming: Format your PDF filename as `Firstname_Lastname_Resume.pdf`.
- 10. File Size Under 1MB: Ensure fast parser ingestion and immediate recruiter preview loading.

## 2. Transforming Weak Bullets into High-Scoring Impact Statements

- Weak: 'Created a weather app using React and an external API.'
- ATS Optimized: 'Engineered a real-time weather analytics dashboard using React 18, TypeScript, and OpenWeatherMap API with debounced search and localStorage caching, achieving sub-100ms UI render times across 500+ active user queries.'

faq.q: What is considered a good ATS match score?
faq.a: An ATS match score of 80% or higher is generally considered excellent and will successfully pass automated knockout filters at top tech companies.

faq.q: Does ATS reject resumes if they don't have a summary section?
faq.a: No. For freshers and entry-level software engineers, a summary section is optional and often wastes valuable space. Highlighting technical skills and projects is far more impactful.
